system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you summon two or more clones or Bunshin, and a hostile creature is within 60 feet of you, you can spend 1 Superiority Die to flank them. For every Bunshin you summon into an adjacent space around the them the target suffers a -1 penalty to their next Strength, Dexterity or Constitution saving throw until the end of your next turn, up to a max of -3.
